title: System design
summary: Design a real service on the sheet while two engineers probe your numbers, choices and failure plans.

phases.title: Intro
phases.goal: Open in about thirty words: first name, round and length, the second interviewer joins later, then ask where they would start, and call show_question.

phases.title: Requirements
phases.goal: Give the prompt and call show_question. Let them scope. Answer with exact numbers from the facts and add each to the brief. Push once for non functional needs if missing.

phases.title: API
phases.goal: Ask for the main calls and core entities. Accept rough signatures. Keep it short.

phases.title: Design
phases.goal: They draw. Ask for one request end to end. Then probe gaps on the board one at a time, by label, with point_at: a missing store, an unexplained arrow, a component they named but never drew.

phases.title: Deep dive
phases.goal: Failure modes and trade-offs: a node or region dies, a hot key, a slow dependency, retries that duplicate work. One failure at a time, built on their own design. The lead opens the phase (senior and above: 'Where would you go deeper?'); the second interviewer takes over only after the candidate has answered.

phases.title: Wrap up
phases.goal: Ask what they would change with another week, then take one question. Close in one line and call end_round.
